set -eu
CERT=/etc/pki/tls/certs/https-8443.crt
KEY=/etc/pki/tls/private/https-8443.key
RENEW_BEFORE=604800
if [ "${FORCE_RENEW:-0}" != 1 ] && [ -s "$CERT" ] && [ -s "$KEY" ] && openssl x509 -checkend "$RENEW_BEFORE" -noout -in "$CERT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "certificate is valid beyond renewal threshold"
  exit 0
fi
host=$(hostname -s)
ip=$(hostname -I | awk '{print $1}')
tmp=$(mktemp -d /etc/pki/tls/https-renew.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -sha256 -nodes -days 30 \
  -subj "/CN=$host" -addext "subjectAltName=DNS:$host,IP:$ip" \
  -keyout "$tmp/key" -out "$tmp/cert" >/dev/null 2>&1
openssl x509 -in "$tmp/cert" -noout -checkend 1 >/dev/null
chmod 0600 "$tmp/key"
chmod 0644 "$tmp/cert"
chown root:root "$tmp/key" "$tmp/cert"
mv -f "$tmp/key" "$KEY"
mv -f "$tmp/cert" "$CERT"
restorecon "$KEY" "$CERT" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
if systemctl is-active --quiet nginx; then
  nginx -t
